senses.en: a short, stiff hair on an animal or brush
to react angrily or defensively
(bristle with) to be full of something

ex.en: She began to bristle when he criticized her work in front of everyone.
ex.zh: 他當眾批評她的工作時，她立刻火冒三丈。

senses.en: a female figure with a helmet, shield, and trident that symbolizes Britain; the Latin name for Britain
senses.zh: 不列顛尼亞（英國的擬人化象徵；不列顛的拉丁名）

ex.en: Old British coins show Britannia holding a shield and trident.
ex.zh: 英國舊硬幣上印著手持盾牌和三叉戟的不列顛尼亞女神。

root.note: 不列顛的拉丁名

senses.en: a word or phrase typical of British English

ex.en: "Queue" instead of "line" is a common Briticism.
ex.zh: 用 queue 而不是 line，是很常見的英式用語。

root.note: 英國特有的用語

senses.en: hard but easily broken
(of a person or situation) fragile or unstable; sharp and tense

ex.en: Old bones become brittle and break easily.
ex.zh: 老化的骨頭會變脆，很容易骨折。

senses.en: to raise a difficult subject for discussion
to pierce or open a container to draw out liquid

ex.en: I wasn't sure how to broach the topic of money with my parents.
ex.zh: 我不知道要怎麼跟爸媽提起錢的事。

mn: broach（提出話題）和 brooch（胸針）同音。

senses.en: to send out a program on television or radio
a radio or television program
to tell something to many people

ex.en: The station will broadcast the game live tonight.
ex.zh: 電視台今晚將現場直播這場比賽。

root.note: 原指大範圍撒種子 → 廣播

senses.en: a heavy, ankle-high work shoe

ex.en: The farmer laced up each muddy brogan before heading to the barn.
ex.zh: 農夫把沾滿泥巴的粗工作鞋一隻隻繫好，才去穀倉。

root.note: 粗鞋

senses.en: a strong regional accent, especially Irish or Scottish
senses.zh: （愛爾蘭、蘇格蘭等的）鄉音；口音

senses.en: a strong leather shoe with decorative holes

ex.en: The old fisherman spoke with a thick Irish brogue.
ex.zh: 那位老漁夫說話帶著濃濃的愛爾蘭口音。

senses.en: the business of a broker; a company that buys and sells for clients
the fee charged by a broker

ex.en: She opened an account with an online brokerage to buy stocks.
ex.zh: 她在一家網路證券商開戶買股票。

root.note: 經紀人的業務或費用

senses.en: a reddish-brown liquid chemical element with a strong smell (Br)

ex.en: Bromine is one of the few elements that is liquid at room temperature.
ex.zh: 溴是少數在室溫下呈液態的元素之一。

root.note: 氣味難聞的元素 → 溴

senses.en: inflammation of the tubes that carry air to the lungs

ex.en: His cold turned into bronchitis, and he coughed for weeks.
ex.zh: 他的感冒轉成支氣管炎，咳了好幾個星期。

root.note: 支氣管發炎

senses.en: either of the two main tubes that carry air from the windpipe to the lungs (plural: bronchi)

ex.en: The scan showed a small blockage in the left bronchus.
ex.zh: 掃描顯示左側支氣管有輕微阻塞。

root.note: 氣管的分支 → 支氣管

senses.en: a decorative pin worn on clothing

ex.en: She wore her grandmother's silver brooch on her coat.
ex.zh: 她在外套上別著奶奶的銀胸針。

mn: brooch 雖然拼 oo，卻唸 [o]，和 broach 同音。

senses.en: friendship and loyalty between people
an organization or group of people with common interests

ex.en: The soldiers felt a deep sense of brotherhood after the war.
ex.zh: 戰後，士兵們之間有著深厚的袍澤之情。

root.note: 兄弟的關係 → 情誼

senses.en: to frighten someone into doing something with threats or harsh words

ex.en: The manager tried to browbeat his staff into working late.
ex.zh: 經理試圖威逼員工加班。

root.note: 皺眉瞪人來打壓 → 恫嚇

senses.en: abrupt and short in speech or manner; rudely brief

ex.en: The doctor's brusque manner made the patient feel ignored.
ex.zh: 醫生冷淡唐突的態度讓病人覺得被忽視。

senses.en: a person who acts in a silly way to make people laugh; a fool

ex.en: He acted like a buffoon at the party to get attention.
ex.zh: 他在派對上像個小丑一樣耍寶，只為了引人注意。

senses.en: silly or foolish behavior meant to be funny

ex.en: The teacher had no patience for buffoonery during the exam.
ex.zh: 考試期間，老師完全無法容忍耍寶的行為。

root.note: 小丑的行為

senses.en: round or bulging in shape
(of a plant) growing from a bulb

ex.en: The cartoon character had a bulbous red nose.
ex.zh: 那個卡通角色有個圓鼓鼓的紅鼻子。

root.note: 像球莖的 → 圓鼓鼓的

senses.en: a young castrated bull

ex.en: The farmer used a bullock to pull the heavy cart.
ex.zh: 農夫用一頭閹牛拉那輛沉重的車。

root.note: 小公牛

senses.en: a tall grasslike plant that grows in or near water

ex.en: A heron stood still among the bulrush at the edge of the pond.
ex.zh: 一隻蒼鷺靜靜地站在池塘邊的蘆葦叢中。

root.note: 大型的燈心草

senses.en: a defensive wall
a person or thing that protects or defends

ex.en: A free press is a bulwark against government corruption.
ex.zh: 新聞自由是對抗政府貪腐的堡壘。

senses.en: a bar at the front or back of a car that protects it in a crash
unusually large or plentiful

ex.en: Farmers expect a bumper crop of apples this year.
ex.zh: 農民預計今年蘋果會大豐收。

root.note: 承受碰撞的東西 → 保險桿

senses.en: irritatingly self-important and pushy

ex.en: The bumptious new intern kept telling senior staff how to do their jobs.
ex.zh: 那個自以為是的新實習生一直教資深員工怎麼做事。

root.note: 到處碰撞、強出頭 → 自以為是的

senses.en: to do a task badly or clumsily

ex.en: If you rush the job, you might bungle it completely.
ex.zh: 如果你急著完成，可能會把事情全搞砸。

senses.en: the ability to float in water or air
cheerfulness; the ability to recover quickly
(of an economy) a high level of activity

ex.en: Salt water has greater buoyancy than fresh water.
ex.zh: 鹹水的浮力比淡水大。

root.note: 像浮標一樣浮起的能力 → 浮力

senses.en: able to float
cheerful and optimistic
(of an economy or market) strong and active

ex.en: Despite the bad news, she remained buoyant and hopeful.
ex.zh: 儘管聽到壞消息，她依然樂觀並充滿希望。

root.note: 像浮標一樣浮著的 → 能漂浮的；心情輕快的

senses.en: a government department or an office for a particular type of business
a chest of drawers or a writing desk

ex.en: The weather bureau issued a warning about the coming typhoon.
ex.zh: 氣象局針對即將來襲的颱風發布警報。

parts.m: desk, cloth 書桌、桌布（法文）

root.note: 桌子 → 辦公的地方 → 局

senses.en: a system of government run by many officials with complicated rules
too many complicated rules and procedures

ex.en: Getting a permit took months because of all the bureaucracy.
ex.zh: 因為層層的官僚程序，申請許可證花了好幾個月。

root.note: 由辦公室統治 → 官僚體制

senses.en: (historical) a citizen of a town or borough with full rights; an elected representative

ex.en: In colonial Virginia, each county elected a burgess to the assembly.
ex.zh: 在殖民時期的維吉尼亞，每個郡都會選出一名議員進入議會。

root.note: 城鎮的居民 → 市民

senses.en: (old use) a citizen of a town, especially a wealthy middle-class one

ex.en: The painting shows a proud Dutch burgher in a black coat.
ex.zh: 這幅畫描繪一位身穿黑外套、神情自豪的荷蘭市民。

root.note: 城鎮裡的人 → 市民

senses.en: to polish metal by rubbing
to improve someone's image or reputation

ex.en: The company hired a PR firm to burnish its image after the scandal.
ex.zh: 醜聞過後，公司聘請公關公司來提升形象。

parts.m: brown, shine 棕色、發亮（古法文 brunir）

root.note: 使發亮 → 擦亮

senses.en: a person who manages the money of a school or college

ex.en: Students must pay their fees at the bursar's office before classes begin.
ex.zh: 學生必須在開學前到會計室繳交學費。

root.note: 掌管錢包的人 → 財務主管

senses.en: to move around in a busy, energetic way
excited and noisy activity

ex.en: I love the hustle and bustle of the night market.
ex.zh: 我喜歡夜市熙熙攘攘的熱鬧氣氛。

mn: 常見片語 hustle and bustle，意為「熙來攘往、熱鬧忙碌」。

senses.en: to hit with the head or horns
a person who is often mocked
the thick end of a tool or weapon; the end of a cigarette

ex.en: He was tired of being the butt of everyone's jokes.
ex.zh: 他受夠了一直當大家的笑柄。

mn: butt in 是口語的「插嘴、干涉」。

senses.en: an isolated hill with steep sides and a flat top

ex.en: A red rock butte rose sharply from the desert floor.
ex.zh: 一座紅色岩石的平頂孤山從沙漠地面陡然聳起。

senses.en: a structure built against a wall to support it
to support or strengthen an argument or idea

ex.en: She used data from three studies to buttress her argument.
ex.zh: 她用三項研究的數據來支持她的論點。

senses.en: a rule made by a local authority or an organization for its members

ex.en: A city by-law bans loud music after ten at night.
ex.zh: 一條市府規章禁止晚上十點後大聲播放音樂。

parts.m: town 城鎮（古北歐語 býr）

root.note: 城鎮自訂的法律 → 地方法規

senses.en: a small secret group plotting to gain political power

ex.en: A cabal of advisers secretly controlled the king's decisions.
ex.zh: 一群顧問組成的小圈子暗中操控國王的決策。

parts.m: kabbalah 猶太神祕教義（希伯來文）

root.note: 神祕教義 → 祕密小團體

senses.en: secret or mystical teachings, especially the Jewish Kabbalah; the use of obscure symbols
senses.zh: 神祕教義；（猶太）卡巴拉學說

ex.en: The old manuscript was full of cabalism and strange symbols.
ex.zh: 那份古老手稿充滿了神祕教義和奇怪的符號。

root.note: 神祕教義的學說

senses.en: a cupboard with shelves or drawers
the group of senior ministers who advise a head of government

ex.en: The president met with his cabinet to discuss the crisis.
ex.zh: 總統與內閣開會討論這場危機。

root.note: 小房間 → 櫥櫃；密室議事 → 內閣

senses.en: very pale, thin, and bony, like a corpse
senses.zh: 面如死灰的；骨瘦如柴的

ex.en: After months of illness, he looked cadaverous.
ex.zh: 病了幾個月後，他看起來形容枯槁。

root.note: 像屍體的 → 面如死灰的

senses.en: the rise and fall of the voice in speaking
a rhythm or beat; (music) the ending of a phrase

ex.en: The soothing cadence of her voice helped the children fall asleep.
ex.zh: 她聲音溫柔的抑揚頓挫讓孩子們漸漸入睡。

root.note: 聲音的起落 → 抑揚頓挫

senses.en: a showy solo passage in a concerto for a soloist to display skill

ex.en: The violinist played a dazzling cadenza near the end of the concerto.
ex.zh: 小提琴家在協奏曲接近尾聲時演奏了一段炫目的華彩樂段。

root.note: 源自 cadence，出現在樂曲收尾之前 → 華彩樂段

senses.en: (old use) a cowardly or despicable person
cowardly and base

ex.en: In the old ballad, the caitiff runs away and leaves his friends to fight alone.
ex.zh: 在那首古老的歌謠裡，那個懦夫逃走了，讓朋友們獨自作戰。

root.note: 俘虜 → 可憐人 → 卑鄙的人

senses.en: to persuade someone by flattery or gentle urging

ex.en: She tried to cajole her brother into lending her his car.
ex.zh: 她想用好話哄哥哥把車借給她。

senses.en: the use of flattery or coaxing to persuade someone

ex.en: No amount of cajolery could change the stubborn old man's mind.
ex.zh: 再多的甜言蜜語也改變不了那個固執老人的心意。

root.note: 哄騙的行為

senses.en: able to be measured or calculated

ex.en: The risk is small but calculable.
ex.zh: 風險雖小，但可以估算出來。

root.note: 可以計算的

senses.en: the branch of mathematics dealing with rates of change and areas
a particular method of reasoning or calculation
a hard stone formed in the body

ex.en: She is taking calculus in her senior year of high school.
ex.zh: 她高三要修微積分。

parts.m: limestone, pebble 石灰石、小石子

root.note: 古羅馬人用小石子計算 → 微積分

senses.en: a hard, thick area of skin; a callus
lack of feeling; insensitivity

ex.en: Years of guitar playing left a callosity on each fingertip.
ex.zh: 多年彈吉他在每根指尖都留下了一層老繭。

root.note: 皮膚變硬 → 老繭

senses.en: young and inexperienced; immature

ex.en: He was a callow youth when he first arrived in the big city.
ex.zh: 他初到大城市時，還是個少不更事的年輕人。

senses.en: a unit for measuring the energy value of food

ex.en: A can of soda contains nearly 150 calories, so check the calorie count first.
ex.zh: 一罐汽水大約含一百五十大卡，所以先看看熱量標示。

root.note: 熱量單位

senses.en: a false statement made to damage someone's reputation

ex.en: The senator dismissed the accusation as pure calumny.
ex.zh: 那位參議員駁斥這項指控純屬誹謗。

parts.m: trick, deceive 欺騙（拉丁文 calvi）

root.note: 欺騙性的言論 → 誹謗

senses.en: the hill outside Jerusalem where Jesus was crucified
(calvary) an experience of great suffering

ex.en: The painting shows three crosses on the hill of Calvary.
ex.zh: 這幅畫描繪了各各他山上的三座十字架。

root.note: 「髑髏地」之意

mn: Calvary（各各他）和 cavalry（騎兵）字母順序很像，別搞混。

senses.en: the Protestant teachings of John Calvin, stressing God's power and predestination

ex.en: Calvinism had a strong influence on the Puritans of New England.
ex.zh: 喀爾文主義對新英格蘭的清教徒影響深遠。

root.note: 喀爾文的學說

senses.en: to convert to or make consistent with Calvinism

ex.en: Reformers hoped to Calvinize the churches of Scotland.
ex.zh: 宗教改革者希望讓蘇格蘭的教會改信喀爾文主義。

root.note: 使成為喀爾文派

senses.en: past tense of come
a thin grooved strip of lead that holds pieces of glass in a stained-glass window

ex.en: The artist bent each lead came to hold the small pieces of colored glass.
ex.zh: 藝術家把每根鉛條彎好，用來固定一片片的彩色玻璃。

mn: 這裡收錄的是名詞「鉛條」的罕用義；平常看到的 came 是 come 的過去式。

senses.en: a small part in a film or play played by a famous actor
a piece of jewelry with a raised carved design

ex.en: The author made a cameo appearance in the film version of her book.
ex.zh: 作者在她的小說改編電影中客串演出。

senses.en: an organized series of actions to achieve a goal
a series of military operations
to work in an organized way toward a goal

ex.en: The students started a campaign to reduce plastic waste at school.
ex.zh: 學生們發起一項減少校園塑膠垃圾的運動。

root.note: 原指在野外作戰 → 戰役 → 活動

senses.en: a member of the ancient people living in Canaan before the Israelites
relating to Canaan or its people

ex.en: Archaeologists found a Canaanite temple buried under the city.
ex.zh: 考古學家在城市底下發現一座迦南神廟。

root.note: 迦南的人

senses.en: a small yellow songbird often kept as a pet
bright yellow

ex.en: Miners once used a canary to detect poisonous gas underground.
ex.zh: 礦工過去會用金絲雀來偵測地底的毒氣。

root.note: 原產於加那利群島的鳥 → 金絲雀

mn: a canary in a coal mine 比喻「危險的早期警訊」。

senses.en: truthful and direct; frank
(of a photo) taken informally, without the subject posing

ex.en: Thank you for your candid feedback on my essay.
ex.zh: 謝謝你對我的文章提出坦率的意見。

root.note: 純白無瑕的 → 坦率的

senses.en: relating to dogs
a dog; a pointed tooth between the incisors and molars

ex.en: The airport uses a canine unit to sniff out illegal drugs.
ex.zh: 機場用緝毒犬隊來嗅出非法藥物。

root.note: 狗的

senses.en: a general rule or principle by which something is judged
a collection of works considered the most important or genuine
a church law; a clergyman of a cathedral

ex.en: Shakespeare's plays are central to the canon of English literature.
ex.zh: 莎士比亞的劇作是英國文學經典的核心。

parts.m: rule, measuring rod 規則、量尺（希臘文）

root.note: 量尺 → 標準 → 公認的經典

mn: canon（準則、經典）和 cannon（大砲）只差一個 n。

senses.en: insincere talk about moral or religious matters
the special language of a particular group; jargon
to tilt or slope

ex.en: His speech about honesty was just empty cant.
ex.zh: 他那篇關於誠實的演說只不過是虛偽的空話。

parts.m: sing, chant 唱（拉丁文 cantare）

root.note: 像唸經般重複的話 → 偽善言詞

senses.en: a musical work for voices and instruments, often on a religious subject

ex.en: The choir performed a Bach cantata at the Christmas concert.
ex.zh: 合唱團在聖誕音樂會上演唱了一首巴哈的清唱劇。

root.note: 唱的作品 → 清唱劇

senses.en: one of the main divisions of a long poem

ex.en: We read the first canto of Dante's Inferno in class.
ex.zh: 我們在課堂上讀了但丁《地獄篇》的第一章。

root.note: 一段歌 → 長詩的一章

senses.en: a military camp or quarters, especially a permanent one

ex.en: The soldiers returned to the cantonment after a week of training.
ex.zh: 士兵們在一週訓練後回到營區。

root.note: 劃出來駐紮的區域 → 營地

senses.en: having a lot of space inside; roomy

ex.en: She carried everything she needed in one capacious bag.
ex.zh: 她把所有需要的東西都裝進一個容量很大的包包裡。

root.note: 能容納很多的 → 寬敞的

senses.en: any of the tiny blood vessels connecting arteries and veins
very thin like a hair; relating to capillaries

ex.en: Oxygen passes from each capillary into the surrounding cells.
ex.zh: 氧氣從每一條微血管進入周圍的細胞。

root.note: 細如毛髮的 → 微血管

senses.en: to stop resisting and give in to an opponent or demand

ex.en: After a long strike, the company was forced to capitulate to the workers' demands.
ex.zh: 經過長期罷工，公司被迫屈服於工人的要求。

root.note: 按條款談定（投降條件）→ 投降

senses.en: a sudden, unexplained change of mind or behavior

ex.en: The schedule changed at the manager's caprice, confusing everyone.
ex.zh: 行程隨著經理一時興起而變動，讓大家無所適從。

parts.m: goat 山羊（一說 capo 頭）

root.note: 像山羊亂跳般 → 反覆無常

senses.en: a title or short explanation under a picture
words shown on screen during a film or video

ex.en: She wrote a funny caption for the photo of her dog.
ex.zh: 她為狗狗的照片寫了一段有趣的說明。

root.note: 抓住重點的文字 → 標題

senses.en: tending to find fault or raise petty objections

ex.en: The captious critic complained about every tiny detail of the film.
ex.zh: 那位吹毛求疵的影評人對電影的每個小細節都有意見。

root.note: 愛抓別人小辮子的 → 吹毛求疵的

senses.en: to attract and hold the attention or interest of

ex.en: The magician's tricks never fail to captivate young audiences.
ex.zh: 魔術師的把戲總能迷住年輕觀眾。

root.note: 使成為俘虜 → 迷住

senses.en: the dead body of an animal
the remaining framework of something

ex.en: Vultures circled above the carcass of a zebra.
ex.zh: 禿鷹在一具斑馬屍體上空盤旋。
